singleTakeaway: Lucius takes repetitive Discord support off the human team.
tension: Large Discord communities overload small teams with repetitive support questions.
The pain is not only response speed; it is humans staying on-call all the time.
proof: Lucius basically gave me my holidays back.
nonGoals: Do not turn this into a full narrative case study.
Do not invent response-time or queue metrics.
Do not introduce flashy AI spectacle that fights the proof.
